            family=self.home_family,
            role="PARENT",
            is_admin=True,
        )
        self.user.profile.primary_family = self.home_family
        self.user.profile.save()

        self.direct_group = FamilyGroup.objects.create(name="Thunder Baseball")

            family=self.direct_group, defaults={"type": "EXTENDED"}
        )

            user=self.user,
            family=self.direct_group,
            role="OTHER",
            is_admin=False,
        )

        self.managed_group = FamilyGroup.objects.create(name="School Circle")
        FamilyGroupType.objects.update_or_create(
            family=self.managed_group, defaults={"type": "CIRCLE"}
        )
        FamilyMembership.objects.create(
            user=self.user,
            family=self.managed_group,
            role="ORGANIZER",

        self.network_group = FamilyGroup.objects.create(name="Obies Network")

            family=self.connected_family, defaults={"type": "IMMEDIATE"}

            meta_family=self.network_group,
        )

    def test_family_management_groups_workspace_directory_and_labels_network_connections(
        self,
    ) -> None:
        response = self.client.get(reverse("family_management"))

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        sections = response.context["group_sections"]
        section_ids = [section["id"] for section in sections]

        self.assertEqual(section_ids, ["home", "managed", "direct", "connected"])

        connected_section = next(
            section for section in sections if section["id"] == "connected"
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(connected_section["items"]), 2)

        connected_names = [item.family.name for item in connected_section["items"]]
        self.assertIn("Duszak Family", connected_names)
        self.assertIn("Obies Network", connected_names)

        connected_family_item = next(
            item
            for item in connected_section["items"]
            if item.family.name == "Duszak Family"
        )
        self.assertIn("Obies Network", connected_family_item.connection_labels)

            expires_at=timezone.now() + timedelta(days=7),
        )

            reverse("invitations_dashboard"),
            {"tab": "sent", "family": str(self.home_family.id)},
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(response.context["selected_family_filter"], self.home_family)

            ["home@example.com"],

            invite_code="network-review",
            invitation_context="META_JOIN",
            status="PENDING",
            expires_at=timezone.now() + timedelta(days=3),
